europe_now.title: Russian Missile Attacks Damage Kyiv Infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Recent missile strikes hit multiple bridges and caused damage within Kyiv during a major assault. The attacks also affected diplomatic missions in the capital.

sources.headline: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack

europe_now.title: EU and UK Prepare for Brussels Summit Deals
europe_now.summary: European and British leaders are convening in Brussels to discuss and sign bilateral agreements covering trade, energy, and youth mobility. Discussions also encompass post-Brexit arrangements and reducing regulatory friction.

sources.headline: EU and UK set to sign deals on trade, energy, youth mobility at Brussels summit

top_stories.title: Regional Security and Ukraine Strategy
top_stories.summary: European leaders have expressed readiness to engage in talks regarding the war in Ukraine. Meanwhile, discussions among officials have touched upon security guarantees and potential alliance frameworks.
